title: The Ambassador's Daily Revelation and the Five Works of Fire
description: T68 reads the sun's daily rising and setting as two great mysteries of the Lord's call. At dawn, every creature of flesh recoils as the Radiance falls; the multitude of the natural mind shuts its mouth and the night withdraws — a sign of the first contest when the Lord first comes forth as Divine Human into the soul organized by self-love. At dusk, the people withdraw to their hiding-places — a sign of the consummation, when all that is the Lord's is recognized and refined out, while the proprium is shut into the region where the sun does not shine. T69 names the five works of love-as-fire: it consumes whatever is laid upon it; from one fuel it draws four distinct things; it gives taste and savor; every artisan shapes vessels by means of it; it manifests a light by which the soul sees. Where love is, sight is given.
